verses.original: Ἐὰν λαλῶ ταῖς γλώσσαις τῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ τῶν ἀγγέλων δὲ ἔχω μὴ ἀγάπην γέγονα ἠχῶν χαλκὸς ἢ ἀλαλάζον κύμβαλον
verses.transliteration: Ean lalō tais glōssais tōn anthrōpōn kai tōn angelōn de echō mē agapēn gegona ēchōn chalkos ē alalazon kymbalon
verses.literal: If I speak in the tongues - of men and - of angels but have not love I am [only a] ringing gong or [a] clanging cymbal

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν ἔχω προφητείαν καὶ εἰδῶ πάντα τὰ μυστήρια καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γνῶσιν καὶ ἐὰν ἔχω πᾶσαν τὴν πίστιν ὥστε μεθιστάναι ὄρη δὲ ἔχω μὴ ἀγάπην εἰμι οὐθέν
verses.transliteration: kai ean echō prophēteian kai eidō panta ta mystēria kai pasan tēn gnōsin kai ean echō pasan tēn pistin hōste methistanai orē de echō mē agapēn eimi outhen
verses.literal: - If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all - mysteries and all - knowledge and if I have absolute - faith so as to move mountains but have not love I am nothing

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν ψωμίσω πάντα μου τὰ ὑπάρχοντά καὶ ἐὰν ἵνα καυχήσωμαι παραδῶ μου τὸ σῶμά δὲ ἔχω μὴ ἀγάπην ὠφελοῦμαι οὐδὲν
verses.transliteration: kai ean psōmisō panta mou ta hyparchonta kai ean hina kauchēsōmai paradō mou to sōma de echō mē agapēn ōpheloumai ouden
verses.literal: - If I give all I - possess {to the poor} and - - exult in the surrender of my - body but have not love I gain nothing

verses.original: Ἡ ἀγάπη μακροθυμεῖ ἡ ἀγάπη χρηστεύεται ἡ ἀγάπη οὐ ζηλοῖ οὐ περπερεύεται οὐ φυσιοῦται
verses.transliteration: Hē agapē makrothymei hē agapē chrēsteuetai hē agapē ou zēloi ou perpereuetai ou physioutai
verses.literal: - Love is patient - love is kind - [It] vvv does not envy vvv it does not boast vvv it is not proud

verses.original: οὐκ ἀσχημονεῖ οὐ ζητεῖ τὰ ἑαυτῆς οὐ παροξύνεται οὐ λογίζεται τὸ κακόν
verses.transliteration: ouk aschēmonei ou zētei ta heautēs ou paroxynetai ou logizetai to kakon
verses.literal: vvv It is not rude vvv it is not self-seeking . . . . . . vvv it is not easily angered vvv it keeps no account - of wrongs

verses.original: οὐ χαίρει ἐπὶ τῇ ἀδικίᾳ δὲ συνχαίρει τῇ ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: ou chairei epi tē adikia de synchairei tē alētheia
verses.literal: vvv [Love] takes no pleasure in - evil but rejoices in the truth

verses.original: στέγει πάντα πιστεύει πάντα ἐλπίζει πάντα ὑπομένει πάντα
verses.transliteration: stegei panta pisteuei panta elpizei panta hypomenei panta
verses.literal: It bears all things believes all things hopes all things endures all things

verses.original: Ἡ ἀγάπη οὐδέποτε πίπτει δὲ εἴτε προφητεῖαι καταργηθήσονται εἴτε γλῶσσαι παύσονται εἴτε γνῶσις καταργηθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Hē agapē oudepote piptei de eite prophēteiai katargēthēsontai eite glōssai pausontai eite gnōsis katargēthēsetai
verses.literal: - Love never fails But where [there are] prophecies they will cease where [there are] tongues they will be restrained where [there is] knowledge it will be dismissed

verses.original: γὰρ γινώσκομεν ἐκ μέρους καὶ προφητεύομεν ἐκ μέρους
verses.transliteration: gar ginōskomen ek merous kai prophēteuomen ek merous
verses.literal: For we know in part and we prophesy in part

verses.original: δὲ ὅταν τὸ τέλειον ἔλθῃ τὸ ἐκ μέρους καταργηθήσεται
verses.transliteration: de hotan to teleion elthē to ek merous katargēthēsetai
verses.literal: but when the perfect comes the vvv partial passes away

verses.original: Ὅτε ἤμην νήπιος ἐλάλουν ὡς νήπιος ἐφρόνουν ὡς νήπιος ἐλογιζόμην ὡς νήπιος ὅτε γέγονα ἀνήρ κατήργηκα τὰ τοῦ νηπίου
verses.transliteration: Hote ēmēn nēpios elaloun hōs nēpios ephronoun hōs nēpios elogizomēn hōs nēpios hote gegona anēr katērgēka ta tou nēpiou
verses.literal: When I was a child I talked like a child I thought like a child I reasoned like a child When I became a man I set aside vvv vvv childish ways

verses.original: γὰρ ἄρτι βλέπομεν ἐν αἰνίγματι δι’ ἐσόπτρου δὲ τότε πρόσωπον πρὸς πρόσωπον ἄρτι γινώσκω ἐκ μέρους δὲ τότε ἐπιγνώσομαι καὶ καθὼς ἐπεγνώσθην
verses.transliteration: gar arti blepomen en ainigmati di’ esoptrou de tote prosōpon pros prosōpon arti ginōskō ek merous de tote epignōsomai kai kathōs epegnōsthēn
verses.literal: - Now we see vvv but a dim reflection as in a mirror - then [we shall see] face to face Now I know in part - then I shall know fully even as I am fully known

verses.original: δὲ Νυνὶ ταῦτα τρία τὰ μένει πίστις ἐλπίς ἀγάπη δὲ μείζων τούτων ἡ ἀγάπη
verses.transliteration: de Nyni tauta tria ta menei pistis elpis agapē de meizōn toutōn hē agapē
verses.literal: And now these three - remain faith hope [and] love but [the] greatest of these [is] - love
